item.title: Drought Surcharge on Your Water Bill: What It Is and Why You
item.description:
Quick Answer

**A drought surcharge** is an extra fee water utilities add during dry periods to discourage high usage and cover increased supply costs. The fee is **tiered based on usage**—the more water you consume, especially outdoors, the higher the charge.

  • Drought surcharges add **$7-$76 per month** to your bill depending on usage tier
  • Example: Denver Water charges **$1.10 per 1,000 gallons** in Tier 2 and **$2.20 per 1,000 gallons** in Tier 3

Track your [monthly water usage](/blog/05-how-to-lower-utility-bills) to stay in lower tiers and reduce costs.
